item.property_change: Hardness values superior to many other RHEAs; 676 HV vs 298 HV for cast NbTaTiV
item.attributed_mechanism: Powder metallurgy route with fine-grained microstructures and Hall-Petch strengthening enhances hardness
quotes: The hardness of the bulk RHEAs studied herein exhibit values superior to many other RHEAs reported in the literature.
When the powder metallurgy route is chosen, increased milling times combined with short sintering times lead to more fine-grained microstructures compared to cast materials.
For instance, one can see that the PM Al 0.3 NbTa 0.8 Ti 1.5 V 0.2 Zr alloys in this study showed values of 676 HV, while a NbTaTiV cast alloy was reported to have values as low as 298 HV.
